last_session.text: Drop Dead Ned's wasp broke apart the undead knight Sir Alfred, and the party left him incapacitated but not destroyed.
Dr. Uriah's new spell located the dragon's lair on the treasure map. The witch Vivian advised drugging the dragon with faun wine.
Wayman persuaded the goblins to wall off the mound's upper rooms and destroy its church. The party later trailed drunk goblins to King Hogboon's temple castle.
Dr. Uriah kept the barrow robes after a deal with Brother Dirk, then found they are not magical.
Sir Phidipaldi and Dr. Uriah realized their treasure map came from the dwarf Bral. The map also marks the Dwarven mine.
Sir Phidipaldi persuaded Warwick the smith to lend the party his grandfather's mithril chain shirt.
Cedric and Warwick described their lost supplies, and Warwick pointed the party to a mine in the north.
At Sir Phidipaldi's insistence, Cedric signed a promissory note for the party's barrow treasure.
The party recruited Lady Hilda and the wizard Malzazarik using Cedric's promissory note.
Dunk put on a magic ring from a dead dwarf in the cave-in and met Grimny's ghost.
Grimny's ghost told Dunk he believes his greedy brother Bral murdered him.

open.text: Kill the black dragon and drag its body into Brandonsford to collect Eric the Reeve's 1000 gold.
Find the treasure marked on the party's treasure map.
Fight Eric the Reeve in the dawn duel Sir Phidipaldi challenged him to.
Get Farmer Gill's mule Shamus. Gill asked 100 gold but says he may go lower.
A cave-in seals the Dwarven mine's old entrance, blocking the metal owed to Warwick. It looks natural and can be dug through.
George says arrows and swords failed against the dragon's black scales, and it has a deadly poison bite and spits sulfur. Father William says only Sir Brandon's sword can kill it.
The dragon reported in the Dragon's Lair stands between the party and the hoard there. Dunk suspects there is no dragon, only Bral pretending.
Farmer Gill won't lower his price for Shamus until his boys return, since he can't work without them or a mule.
Farmer Gill says Warwick always refuses to sell the mithril chain shirt he displays.
The treasure map marks the Dragon's Lair. George places it at the foot of the northern mountains, and Grimny says it is one big room.
Sir Phidipaldi carries Sir Brandon's magic sword, which killed the first dragon and is far more effective against evil beings.
The party has enough faun wine. Vivian says enough of it would knock out the dragon so they could drive the sword through its mouth.
Sir Phidipaldi proposes that if the party leaves game dosed with faun wine outside the dragon's cave, they can go in once the dragon eats it.
Lady Hilda and the wizard Malzazarik have joined the party.
Wayman wears Warwick's mithril chain shirt on loan. It greatly improves his protection and halves damage from magic weapons and spells.
Grimny's ghost says Bral probably hid the dwarves' hoard in the Dragon's Lair.
Cedric signed a promissory note for the barrow treasure, worth 975 gold by Dr. Uriah's tally, payable once the caravans flow again.
The borrowed mithril shirt could protect Wayman against the dragon.
Drop Dead Ned travels with the party as a hired scout for a 100 gold fee, carrying tools such as a crowbar.
The party holds a treasure map of sites near Brandonsford, with one marked location still unidentified.
The Barrow Mound mosaics show Sir Brandon killed the first dragon by driving his sword up through its open mouth.
Squints the halfling has joined the party as Trout's junior assistant, taking orders from Trout.
How did Grimny die, and did his brother Bral kill him?
How did Sir Brandon really kill the first dragon?
What happened to Grimny's brothers Grelli, Durney, Brenny, Tedry and Rooney?
Where has this new dragon come from?
What is stopping shipments into Brandonsford, including Bentley's overdue restock?
Whose female voice asked "What makes a true knight?" in the tomb?
Why are the once-hidden fairies now coming out more often?
The party must bring Warwick metal from the Dwarven mine in exchange for the mithril shirt loan. Meanwhile he plays Sir Phidipaldi's lyre each night.
Dr. Uriah owes Father William penance at the Barrow Mound and a 10 gold donation for its upkeep.
The party owes Lady Hilda and Malzazarik pay for joining, pledged against Cedric's 975-gold promissory note.
The party must return the mithril chain shirt Warwick lent them. Warwick holds Sir Phidipaldi's plate armor and lyre as collateral.
Trout must let Squints pick from the Halfling Corps' first treasure after the elite members. Until then Squints pays his own way.
Dr. Uriah must return the barrow robes to the church once the dragon is defeated, as he promised Brother Dirk.
Sir Phidipaldi vowed to George to bring his lance against the dragon.
The black dragon that tore off George's arm is still at large around Brandonsford and may maim others.
George says the dragon can't fly yet but soon will, and then they are doomed.
A slow, man-eating giant in a cyclopean cottage north of Brandonsford is now awake. He chased the party until he tired.
